item.title: BNB Chain Tests 88% TPS Boost With BEP-675 Upgrade
item.summary: BNB Chain has reported strong performance results from BEP-675, a proposed upgrade being tested on the Binance Smart Chain testnet as part of its second-half 2026 scaling roadmap. The proposal increased transaction throughput by 88% during testing, reaching 2,324 transactions per second compared with a baseline of 1,237 TPS.
